topStories.headline: SpaceX (SPCX) Joins Nasdaq-100 Today, Triggering ~$4.3B in Forced Index Buying at Open
topStories.summary: SpaceX's fast-track Nasdaq-100 inclusion is effective at Monday's open, requiring index-tracking funds — including the $800B+ QQQ — to purchase roughly $4.3 billion in SPCX; the stock has surged from its $135 IPO price on June 12 to approximately $171.
topStories.marketImpact: SPCX ↑ mechanical demand at open — watch crowding and mid-week reversal risk; QQQ ↑ marginally on added AI/space-infrastructure exposure

topStories.headline: June Payrolls Miss Deepens Rate-Cut Case — 57K Jobs Added, Well Below 115K Forecast
topStories.summary: The US added only 57,000 nonfarm jobs in June, well below the 115,000 consensus, with leisure and hospitality shedding 61,000 (World Cup drag); April and May were revised down a combined 74,000, and the unemployment rate held at 4.2% only because the labor force participation rate fell to a five-year low of 61.5%.
topStories.marketImpact: S&P 500 ↑ 0.72% to 7,537 and Nasdaq ↑ 1.12% as rate-cut hopes revived; TLT ↑; DXY ↓; July hike odds near zero — July 29 FOMC now the next live meeting

topStories.headline: BofA Warns AI Speculation at 'Extreme Levels,' Sets S&P 500 Year-End Target at 7,100
topStories.summary: Bank of America reaffirmed its year-end S&P 500 target of 7,100 — about 5% below Monday's close of 7,537 — warning that high-multiple AI stocks have 'gapped up demonstrably,' a pattern that has historically preceded a valuation snap-back; Micron is up 242% year-to-date.
topStories.marketImpact: Chip/AI stocks ↓ risk (MU, NVDA, WDC, MRVL most exposed); limited near-term upside thesis for high-multiple names; watch for sector rotation

topStories.headline: SK Hynix $29B Nasdaq ADR (SKHY) Set to Price This Week — Biggest-Ever Foreign US Listing
topStories.summary: South Korea's SK Hynix, Nvidia's top HBM memory supplier with roughly 60% high-bandwidth memory market share, is set to price its $29B Nasdaq ADR with shares expected to begin trading Friday, July 10 — surpassing Alibaba's 2014 IPO as the largest-ever US listing by a foreign company.
topStories.marketImpact: SKHY ↑ potential on AI/HBM demand; ASML ↑ as key EUV capex beneficiary; MU ↓ risk from better-funded competitor entering US capital markets

topStories.headline: Beijing Cracks Down on Cross-Border Trading; Mainland Investors Flock to Hong Kong
topStories.summary: Chinese regulators fined Futu, Tiger Brokers, and Longbridge a combined $330M+ for facilitating unauthorized cross-border stock trading and ordered a two-year phase-out of mainland operations, pushing retail investors toward Hong Kong as a regulated alternative.
topStories.marketImpact: FUTU ↓, TIGR ↓ on direct regulatory hit; HK-listed brokers ↑; Hang Seng ↑ 1.3% to ~23,350 on capital inflow expectations from mainland

topStories.headline: July 24 US Tariff Expiry Looms; Chinese Exporters Rushing Final Shipments
topStories.summary: Chinese exporters are accelerating shipments ahead of the Section 122 tariff (10%) expiry on July 24, helping drive a ~15% YoY export surge in H1 2026; China Q2 GDP and June trade data arrive July 15 and are expected to confirm robust top-line growth from front-running.
topStories.marketImpact: FXI cautiously supported near-term; key risk is Congressional renewal/reinstatement post-July 24; Q2 GDP beat would support 0700.HK, 9988.HK

topStories.headline: USD/JPY Holds at 161 as BOJ Eyes Further Hikes; Finance Minister Repeats Intervention Warning
topStories.summary: USD/JPY trades at 161.87 as the Bank of Japan — which raised rates to 1% in June, the highest since 1995 — signals further hikes are warranted with CPI projected at 2.5–3.0% for FY2026; Finance Minister Katayama reiterated that authorities stand ready to intervene at any time during thin summer liquidity.
topStories.marketImpact: JPY ↑ potential on intervention or BOJ hike; JGBs ↓; 8306.T ↑ on rate normalisation; Nikkei 225 at 69,302 faces headwinds from tighter policy

topStories.headline: Crude Slides Below $69 as Saudi Arabia Recovers Exports and OPEC+ Adds 188K bpd
topStories.summary: WTI fell below $69/bbl and Brent below $72 as Saudi Arabia ramped crude exports back toward pre-conflict levels of ~6.3 million bpd following normalization of Strait of Hormuz shipping; OPEC+ approved a 188,000 bpd output increase for August.
topStories.marketImpact: Energy stocks ↓ (XOM, CVX, XLE); airlines/transport ↑; oil decline eases inflation pressure and provides mild support to risk assets; Goldman Sachs year-end Brent target $80
